payload.title: [Fig. 10] Consistency of the PAGES 2k ensemble
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes the consistency of the PAGES 2k (2019) ensemble of GMST reconstructions by applying inter and intra-ensemble distance metrics. It reproduces Figure 10 from the associated paper. The notebook uses various statistical and visualization techniques to compare different reconstruction methods, including offline DA and LMRv2.1. The analysis involves loading reconstruction data, performing pairwise comparisons, and visualizing results through plots of ensemble traces and distance distributions.
goals: Measure the consistency of the PAGES 2k ensemble using distance metrics.
Reproduce Figure 10 from the PAGES 2k (2019) paper.
Compare offline DA reconstructions with LMRv2.1.
Visualize ensemble traces and distance distributions.

section_blurbs.blurb: Compares the PAGES 2k (2019) ensemble's offline DA reconstruction with LMRv2.1, highlighting differences in proxy sets and visualization of GMST traces.

section_blurbs.blurb: Conducts pairwise comparisons of reconstructions, focusing on the DA method's lack of temporal dependence and using power-law modeling for resampling.
